mentions.name: Streamlit analytics calculator toy
mentions.description: This app is an interactive analytics calculator built in Streamlit that expresses business logic as simple choices and lets the numbers fall out. It encodes a growing set of rules about the author's business and is developed incrementally — adding one small idea at a time, refreshing, and adjusting based on what looks wrong rather than following a spec.
mentions.problem: The author has never coded before and built this to solve their own business analytics problem without writing code in the traditional sense.
mentions.audience: The author, a first-time builder solving their own business problem without traditional coding.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building an analytics calculator/toy that slowly turned into something useful.

It started as curiosity. I wanted to see if I could express business logic as simple choices and let the numbers fall out on their own.

The app is built interactively in Streamlit.
